plan.summary: This 4-week block is the first build phase of a 12-week off-camp boxing plan. Week 1 establishes training maxes on the main lifts so percentage work is accurate, and the main program starts in Week 2. The goal here is to raise the force ceiling with simple, repeatable lifts, keep power work crisp, and leave room for sparring and skill work. Week 4 trims volume for a deload while keeping movement quality and bar speed high.

phaseOverview.label: Building
phaseOverview.focus: Build baseline strength and simple explosive qualities with repeatable lifts that do not steal too much from boxing practice.

phaseOverview.label: Intensifying
phaseOverview.focus: Progress strength and power with slightly heavier work while keeping weekly fatigue recoverable around sparring.

phaseOverview.label: Expressing
phaseOverview.focus: Shift the earlier strength gains toward faster, sharper outputs without forcing a full speed peak.
